/teach.title: Teaching resources for schools on environment and climate
/teach.description: Swechha's Bridge the Gap compendium for teachers and NGOs: eight themes covering air, water, food, waste, energy, trees and climate justice, with 43 sessions.

/teach/before-you-start.title: How to teach sustainability in school — a guide
/teach/before-you-start.description: Education for Sustainable Development, written for the classroom: the four thrusts, learner-centred teaching, simulations, issue analysis and storytelling.

/teach/a-to-z.title: Environmental glossary for students and teachers, A to Z
/teach/a-to-z.description: Plain definitions for 334 environmental terms, from abiotic and acid rain to vermicomposting and zero waste — the glossary from Swechha's teaching compendium.

/teach/sustainable-development.title: Sustainable development lessons and reading for schools
/teach/sustainable-development.description: What development costs and who pays: the three spheres, needs against wants, issue analysis and life-cycle thinking, with eleven sessions for a classroom.

/teach/blowing-in-the-wind.title: Air pollution lesson plans and reading for schools
/teach/blowing-in-the-wind.description: What dirties the air and what it does to a body: sources, the main pollutants, and how air reaches a child's lungs — with three sessions for a classroom.

/teach/water-water-everywhere.title: Water and rivers — school lessons and reading
/teach/water-water-everywhere.description: The water cycle, the ecosystem approach and why a city runs short: eight sessions on footprints, saving water, plastic in the ocean and walking a river.

/teach/food-on-my-plate.title: Where food comes from — school lessons and reading
/teach/food-on-my-plate.description: Food from plants and animals, what is in it and how far it travels: three sessions on tracing a meal to its source and on what food security means.

/teach/future-and-energy.title: Energy and climate — school lessons and reading
/teach/future-and-energy.description: What energy is, where it comes from and what renewables can do: five sessions including a solar purifier, an energy audit and the carbon cycle as a game.

/teach/wasted.title: Waste lessons and reading for schools and teachers
/teach/wasted.description: Industrial, commercial, domestic and agricultural waste, and where each ends up: five sessions including biogas from dung and a walk to a landfill.

/teach/trees-and-forests.title: Trees and forests — school lessons and reading
/teach/trees-and-forests.description: India's forest types and how a tree actually grows: four sessions on measuring twig growth, sketching trees and walking a forest with a class.

/teach/climate-justice.title: Climate justice lessons for students and schools
/teach/climate-justice.description: Who should act, who carries the cost and why that is unequal: four sessions on human rights, climate justice and a role-play game about who moves first.
